p: mountain of God: It was so called after the law was given.
bush: This shows that the Church is not consumed by the fires of affliction, because God is in the midst of it.
LORD saw that he turned aside: Whom he calls the angel in Ex 3:2.
put off thy shoes from off: Resign yourself to me; Ru 4:7, Jos 5:15.
holy ground: Because of my presence.
afraid to look upon God: For sin causes man to fear God's justice.
flowing with milk and honey: Most plentiful of all things.
Now therefore: He heard before, but now he would avenge it.
I: He does not fully disobey God, but acknowledges his own weakness.
Certainly I will be with thee: Neither fear your own weakness, or Pharaoh's tyranny.
AM THAT I AM: The God who has always been, am, and shall be: the God almighty, by whom all things have their being, and the God of mercy, mindful of my promise.
sacrifice to the LORD our God: Because Egypt was full of idolatry, God would appoint them a place where they could serve him purely.
But every woman shall borrow of: This example may not be followed generally: though at God's commandment they did it justly, receiving some recompence for their labours.
